title: Design System: AVOCATO — Base documentaire & Cabinet OS

display.purpose: Hero plaque + doc h1, 1.85rem, brass rule

headline.purpose: Section opener with top hairline, scroll-margin for hash nav.

body.purpose: Prose & table copy at 1.7 LHC, 65–75ch measure.

label.purpose: Nav items, badges, pills, table header (13px 600).

shadows.name: card-rest
shadows.purpose: Card rest on parchment, plus brass double filet

shadows.name: dialog-overlay
shadows.purpose: Modal overlay elevation for conventions/factures dialogs.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default for state transitions (hover, focus, drawer).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Ink field for dossier, convention, facture primary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0f2a44; color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #0f2a44; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 14px; font: 600 13px/1.4 system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.01em; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.92; border-color: #1fa89e; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1fa89e; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: #ffffff; color: #5a6b7b; border: 1px solid #dfd9cd; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; font: 600 13px/1.4 system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: #1c2733; border-color: #1fa89e; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1fa89e; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Icon Button
components.css: .ds-icon-btn { width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #dfd9cd; background: #ffffff; color: #1c2733; font-size: 14px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, background 0.15s ease; } .ds-icon-btn:hover { border-color: #1fa89e; } .ds-icon-btn.active { background: #e4f2f0; color: #0f2a44; border-color: #1fa89e; } .ds-icon-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1fa89e; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tree Item Active
components.description: Active doc in parchment sidebar — teal soft fill + left teal bar.
components.css: .ds-tree-active { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; width: 100%; background: #e4f2f0; color: #0f2a44; border: 0; border-left: 2px solid #1fa89e; border-radius: 7px; padding: 6px 8px; font: 600 13px/1.4 system-ui, sans-serif; text-align: left; } .ds-tree-active .ds-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: #1fa89e; flex: 0 0 7px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Dashboard card & panel — surface on parchment.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; color: #1c2733; border: 1px solid #dfd9cd; border-radius: 10px; padding: 18px 20px; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(15,42,68,0.08); } .ds-card .ds-num { font-size: 1.7rem; font-weight: 700; color: #0f2a44; line-height: 1.1; } .ds-card .ds-lbl { font-size: 12px; color: #5a6b7b; margin-top: 4px; }

components.name: Doc Container
components.description: Vault doc paper — 800px centered, subtle rule on h1.
components.html:
Titre du document

Lecture lisible 65–75ch, interligne 1.7, marqueurs teal.
components.css: .ds-doc { max-width: 800px; margin: 0 auto; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #dfd9cd; border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(15,42,68,0.08); padding: 34px 40px 48px; color: #1c2733; font: 400 16px/1.7 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-doc h1 { font-size: 1.75rem; line-height: 1.25; font-weight: 700; margin: 0 0 6px; padding-bottom: 10px; border-bottom: 2px solid #1fa89e; }

components.name: Pill / Badge
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-block; background: #e4f2f0; color: #0f2a44; border: 1px solid #1fa89e; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 999px; font: 600 12.5px/1.4 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-badge-prospect { display: inline-block; background: #fff3cd; color: #664d03; border: 1px solid #dfd9cd; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 999px; font: 600 11px/1.4 system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Input / Select
components.description: Cabinet forms — search, dossier fields, selects.
components.html: <label class="ds-field">Client / Société *<input class="ds-input" placeholder="Ex: SARL Atlas — M. Alami"></label>
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; font: 600 12px/1.4 system-ui, sans-serif; color: #5a6b7b; } .ds-input { padding: 8px 10px; border: 1px solid #dfd9cd; border-radius: 8px; background: #f7f5f0; color: #1c2733; font: 400 13px/1.4 system-ui, sans-serif; outline: none; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #1fa89e; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #e4f2f0; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #5a6b7b; opacity: 0.8; }

components.name: Table
components.description: Doc + cabinet tables — zebra + hover teal-soft.
components.css: .ds-table-wrap { overflow-x: auto; border: 1px solid #dfd9cd; border-radius: 8px; background: #ffffff; } .ds-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 13px; } .ds-table th, .ds-table td { padding: 9px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid #dfd9cd; text-align: left; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-table th { background: #efece4; font-weight: 650; } .ds-table tbody tr:nth-child(even) { background: #f7f5f0; } .ds-table tbody tr:hover { background: #e4f2f0; }

narrative.overview: A small-city business-lawyer's offline bureau translated to the web: parchment paper, ink, and a single teal tool-mark. No marketing gloss; authority comes from reading clarity and operational tidiness. Light is parchment + white surfaces with ink text; dark is a genuine ink-on-slate inversion for late-night work, not a dimmed clone. Every surface is flat, tonal, and typographically driven — depth is reserved for state. 300px parchment sidebar + 800px read measure + dense operational tables share one ink/teal language across Read (vault) and Operate (cabinet).
keyCharacteristics: Brass hammered #c5a46a hairline on ink #070e1c + parchment #f6f0e3, teal #1a8a7f ≤10% rare
EB Garamond display + Public Sans workhorse, hierarchy by brass rule + weight
Flat tonal layering; shadows only as 1px card rest or dialog overlay, plus light sweep on plaque
Square-ish controls 2px, pills 999px metadata, 320px brass plaque sidebar + 800px read measure
Double-filet or + encrier glass + tabular mono money as signature

rules.name: The One Teal Rule
rules.body: Teal appears on ≤10% of a viewport and only as text, underline, left-border, dot, or thin stroke — never as a large field. Its rarity is the signal.

rules.name: The Parchment Ground Rule
rules.body: Page bg is always parchment (#f7f5f0 light / #10151c dark), not surface white. Cards cut out of it. A white page ground breaks the bureau.

rules.name: The Warm Gray Rule
rules.body: On colored surfaces (ink hero, teal-soft), tint secondary text from that surface's hue or from ink — never neutral #888 gray.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: No imported display serif. All hierarchy lives in the system sans; mono only for code/data.

rules.name: The Measure Rule
rules.body: Body never exceeds 75ch (800px container). A full-bleed paragraph is a defect.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only as 0 1px 3px on cards and overlay on dialogs — no mid-elevation.

rules.name: The No-Halo Rule
rules.body: Zero-offset colored halos/glows are not shadows. Depth has offset + blur or it is decoration.

dos: Do keep doc measure at 800px max and dash at 900px — body 65–75ch is not optional.
Do use parchment as page ground and surface-white only for cards/docs.
Do keep teal to ≤10% as left-border/dot/underline/text — rarity is signal.
Do carry scroll-margin-top:70px on h2/h3/h4 for hash links under sticky topbar.
Do tint secondary text from surface hue on ink/teal-soft surfaces; never #888 gray.
Do preserve tabular numerals for money (mono 12px) and dates.
Do keep control radii 7–8px and pill 999px strictly to metadata/badges.
Do keep elevation flat-by-default (card rest only, dialog overlay) — no mid shadows.
donts: Don't add a kicker/eyebrow above a heading — the heading carries its own weight.
Don't use gradient text, glass/blur as decoration, or geometric masks for photos.
Don't give cards/chips a thick border-left: 4px color stripe — the 2px active border is the only left-border.
Don't introduce a new display serif (Fraunces/Playfair/Cormorant/Lora/Syne) — one-family system sans holds.
Don't scatter teal field fills across a neutral ground — commit to region fields or stay neutral.
Don't use emoji/glyphs as an icon system — authored SVG in one stroke/weight if icons needed.
Don't use hard offset box-shadow:4px 4px 0 zero-blur blocks unless world becomes neobrutalist.
Don't add sparklines/progress rings as placeholder content — show real dossier/échéance/mission data.
